# Passanger rules
Passanger is a learning role on this server.
If you role passanger and go around causing issues you WILL be rolebanned and it is VERY buggy and might not let you latejoin if that happens.
If you want to tide and be a problem then roll for insurgent.
Playing passanger to cause issues maximises the chances of a woman never talking to you again.
- As an insurgent anyone can do anything to you except violating the zero tolerance rules like ERP. - As an insurgent you can cause issues, but don't go out of your way to kill people.
